[!dolt] skip
# Test bd config set/get/list/unset
bd init --prefix test --quiet

bd config set jira.url 'https://example.atlassian.net'
stdout 'Set jira.url'

bd config get jira.url
stdout 'https://example.atlassian.net'

bd config set jira.project 'TEST'
stdout 'Set jira.project'

bd config list
stdout 'jira.url'
stdout 'jira.project'

bd config unset jira.url
stdout 'Unset jira.url'

bd config list
stdout 'jira.project'
! stdout 'example.atlassian.net'
